I removed the `# noqa: C901` I'd added, so the file no longer gains a suppression. The one `noqa` left in the diff is the existing one on `_dump_response_parts`, which only shows because the diff touches that function's context lines. I haven't re-run the hook itself.

To get under ruff's complexity limit without it, I moved the uploaded-file `ActivityMessage` construction out of `_dump_request_parts` into a new module-level helper, `_uploaded_file_activity`. Ruff and pyright are clean on `_adapter.py`, and all 132 tests in `tests/test_ag_ui.py` pass.
